title: Consume official Base v0.19.0
goal: Consume only the official Base v0.19.0 assets through the existing assembler; validate the exact staged tree before the consumer PR.

in: Official four-asset verification of pantheon-base-v0.19.0, exact lock and standard clean rebuild
Keep ops-owned inputs the rebuild would otherwise lose: SecretTextArea under business/shared, k8s namespace locale source JSON, overlay manifest declarations, ops-owned test fixture
Backend build/vet/test, frontend lint/type-check/build/unit, overlay/drift and governance checks on the staged tree
out: New dependencies, gate weakening, assembler changes
Production operations, S3 waiver, maintenance freeze signature

modify: Base-owned shared paths updated by the v0.18.9 to v0.19.0 delta
doNotTouch: Business runtime source beyond the SecretTextArea import path

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Operates official acquisition and assembly; adjusts only ops-owned inputs the rebuild cannot carry

commands: go build / go vet / go test on the staged backend
frontend lint/type-check/build/unit on the staged tree
runtimeEvidence: Hosted CI Linux race and business smoke

runtimeGap: Local Windows race is blocked by ThreadSanitizer allocation (error code 87), identical on the unmodified baseline; business smoke needs the full stack and is left to hosted CI. Independent CODE/ARCH review not performed.
acceptanceCriteria: Four official v0.19.0 assets verified against the published digest and the consumer lock
Staged tree passes overlay/drift, backend, frontend and applicable governance checks before the PR
Hosted required checks pass before merge
implementationNotes: The v0.18.9 consumption was lock-only, so many shared files were stale; v0.19.0 is the first full materialization since, and it surfaced ops inputs living outside declared overlay paths.
business.k8s.namespace.* locale keys were hand-added to generated resources/business/*.ts and would be lost on regeneration; they now live in k8s/locales source JSON.
SecretTextArea sat under frontend/src/components, a generic path the overlay cannot own; it moved to modules/business/shared.
risks: The lock must name the immutable tag commit cc2fe7370a98c2862e2610d79880012971cf57f5.
Two inherited Base docs link to Base-only artifacts; fix is Base-first.
humanGates: Final functional acceptance and merge remain with the maintainer.
